content.name: Prayer of Healing
entries: Up to six creatures of your choice that you can see within range each regain hit points equal to {@dice 2d8} + your spellcasting ability modifier. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the healing increases by {@scaledice 2d8|2-9|1d8} for each slot level above 2nd.

content.name: Prayer of Healing
entries: Up to five creatures of your choice who remain within range for the spell's entire casting gain the benefits of a {@variantrule Short Rest|SRD52} and also regain {@dice 2d8} {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52}. A creature can't be affected by this spell again until that creature finishes a {@variantrule Long Rest|SRD52}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The healing increases by {@scaledice 2d8|2-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 2.
